audit_metadata.title: Model 1 Crop Prediction Failure Root Cause Audit

root_cause_analysis.primary_root_cause: The running live backend config (app/backend/config.py) is hardcoded to load the old, flawed 'models/model1_expanded/best_model.pth' checkpoint (created Oct 9, 31.5 MB), rather than the newly retrained 'models/model1_retrained_v3/best_model.pth' checkpoint. The legacy 'model1_expanded' checkpoint exhibits severe failure on tomato training images (predicting apple with 93% confidence, bellpepper, or cabbage) and suffers from class index divergence (it was trained with 'capsicum' at idx 7 whereas class_mapping.json has 'bellpepper'). Furthermore, the standalone model itself outputs wrong predictions (e.g. apple for tomato), showing that the error originates in the raw model logits, not in downstream safeguards, transforms, or RGB conversion. In contrast, 'models/model1_retrained_v3/best_model.pth' achieves 100% accuracy on tomato training images with >99.7% confidence.
root_cause_analysis.safeguards_impact: The Open-Set Crop Guard (Safeguard B) correctly reflects the raw model's bad predictions. When the model predicts 'apple' with 93% confidence, the crop guard evaluates prototype similarity to 'apple', which fails prototype acceptance because tomato leaves look nothing like apple leaves/fruit, leading to 'uncertain_crop' or 'unsupported_crop' rejection.

recommended_minimal_fix.detail: Point MODEL1_CHECKPOINT to 'models/model1_retrained_v3/best_model.pth' or set MODEL1_CHECKPOINT environment variable.

recommended_minimal_fix.action: Regenerate crop prototypes for Open-Set Crop Guard using model1_retrained_v3 embeddings
recommended_minimal_fix.detail: The current models/model1_expanded/crop_prototypes.npz was computed from the old checkpoint's feature space. Generating prototypes using model1_retrained_v3 will ensure perfect alignment between backbone features and prototype similarity checks.

recommended_minimal_fix.action: Run regression test suite on tomato, strawberry, bellpepper, and apple
recommended_minimal_fix.detail: Verify all canonical crops classify with >95% confidence and pass Open-Set Crop Guard acceptance without false rejection.
